title: Research: audit PR #3182's P104 output support and secondary-cycle binding
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/p104-support-propagation-audit/`, an independent audit of two source-bound claims in PR #3182.

- The subspace-memory output loop exits after its first eligible source. A literal nested-frame path in PR #3019's exact matching reads X1 through helper 201 at cut 594 and writes Y98 at cut 4058, contributing the required correction coefficient -1/2; the legacy output omits it. Removing only that output-loop `break` changes the PR #3019 missing count from 4,783 to 4,247 (one-step memory) or 4,251 (full memory). The same sensitivity check covers all five retained inputs (table below).
- PR #3182 reverses PR #3124's secondary cycle: `[39,154,139,134]` instead of `[39,134,139,154]`. Both packages apply a cycle as `new_M[c_i] = old_M[c_(i+1)]`, so these are different matchings. The reversed one has three incompatible endpoint pairs, `(39,186)`, `(139,23)` and `(154,7)`, with literal separating vectors 148, 113 and 314. Those census inputs are not the actual PR #3124 candidate.

Missing pairs among the 4,992 required correction entries, before and after deleting only the output-loop `break`:

| Retained input | Legacy, either mode | Break removed, one-step memory | Break removed, full memory |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| PR #2981 | 4,781 | 4,395 | 4,397 |
| PR #3013 | 4,783 | 4,253 | 4,257 |
| PR #3019 | 4,783 | 4,247 | 4,251 |
| PR #3124 cycle A | 4,783 | 4,248 | 4,252 |
| PR #3182 cycle B as encoded (incompatible) | 4,783 | 4,264 | 4,268 |

The last row only reproduces the audited input; it is not an admissible matching.

The P104 path is a support witness with helper dirt retained, not a fully restored correction. The repaired counts are sensitivity measurements, not new obstruction theorems. The separate pooled missing pair `(Y71,X102)` survives the read-first control. A synthetic fresh-read discrepancy is explicitly **not** presented as a P104 counterexample: complete untimed read access allows a direct read in that relaxation. PR #3032's different fixed-matching obstruction, the consumer invoices, and the selected frontier are unchanged. Frozen predecessor files are preserved.

## Task and overlap

Task card: `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 6; catalogue scope key `72dfbf0708467ad34793`; refinement `PR3182/support-transfer/read-relay-output-semantics`. Full scope, coverage limits, stopping rule and follow-ups are in `TASK.json`.

Head `faa6323371db1c5fbb43ab04c6e00715d2328bc6` on base main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. Canonical main was fetched again at 17:33 and 17:38 UTC on 2026-10-17 and was unchanged. Exact dependency heads:

- [PR #3182](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3182): `ad848966cd62e13de5ad8d4b5169c221d74d2fcd`.
- [PR #3124](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3124): `ce468c5cf22f59db3071adda269ac4cc16469c8c`.
- [PR #3019](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3019): `44d12bdeb8ade4066645bd968bebd4756b06200a`.
- [PR #3013](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3013): `504dc9a15f7a874a47564cdf3ae6857bbbc8d000`.
- [PR #2981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2981): `3d24b92d8ba057b57cb2d480170ec407520e6882`.

The claim is in [Discussion #2245](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-19001775). Reading the newest handoffs first showed that PR #3032 had already rejected PR #3019's constructive follow-up, and that PR #3182 was archived on main with its scientific review still open. Scope is **refined** to that missing audit, not another matching search or a reconstruction of a predecessor.

Bounded domain: two tiny transfer tests, the five cases encoded by PR #3182, all 2,309 pooled compatibility edges as a control, one explicit helper flag and chronological path, and 16,384 abstract two-layer fixtures. Milestone: audit. No cost reduction is required or claimed; source soundness is necessary before missing-pair screens guide physical completion. The family decision is to stop after this audit; coefficients, restoration and complete consumer costs remain open.

Overlap check: all 251 open PR bodies, including drafts, at 2026-10-17 17:37 UTC and 2,001 Discussion records at 17:27 UTC, both with complete pagination, plus the packages on main and the PR ledger. No other audit of these two routines was found. A snapshot of PR bodies and Discussions does not cover arbitrary diffs or unpublished work and is not a novelty guarantee. A separate open claim in Discussion #2245 audits moved helper 13 on PR #3124's cycle A with literal frames; that is a different implication, and this package does not repeat its flag census.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-support-propagation-audit
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-support-propagation-audit/verify.py
```

Both pass. The registered replay includes eight behavioral groups: wrong timing, wrong endpoint pairing, wrong coefficient, missing output support, incompatible-cycle rejection, source drift, a six-ADD arbitrary-dirty shear, and an independent graph oracle over all 16,384 two-layer abstract fixtures. Full write-all output matrices agree under reversed enumeration. The unchanged PR #3182 verifier also passes its existing receipt; reproducibility does not establish the soundness of its omitted-source inference.

Expected verifier line:

```text
PASS_P104_SUPPORT_PROPAGATION_AUDIT tiny=2 matchings=5 path=X1-H201-Y98 pooled_missing=1 no_new_kappa
```

Metadata/pin checks pass. All 17 package and input files match the committed bytes; export integrity and optimized direct replay from a fresh Git-free export also pass. `SOURCES.json` binds nine live scientific/code inputs; the selected record is additionally declared for the predecessor module's repository-location check. The complete five-case table and literal flag are in `RESULT.json`. Geometry and interval routines are reused and credited; the tiny semantic tests, literal endpoint/path checks and set/BFS control are separately implemented. No formal kernel or independent human review is claimed.

Not run or supplied: native regeneration, physical hosting, whole-correction coefficient synthesis, arbitrary-dirty restoration of the actual P104 path, proof of the remaining memory recurrence, complete global moment/stock/precision admission, or the selected cold replay. No restored supplier or new kappa follows.

## Open next questions

The package's `README.md` and structured `TASK.json` name two bounded follow-ups: prove a repaired necessary support recurrence before interpreting new missing-pair counts, and bind the actual PR #3124 secondary cycle before using its moved-slot census. Start with the literal X1-H201-Y98 witness, the all-source output fixture, and endpoint-compatibility rejection. Joint flags, chronological coefficients, dirty restoration and a favorable physical bill remain separate requirements.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

Reading the latest merged archives prevented repeating PR #3019's already-rejected construction handoff. PR #3182's ordinary replay passes despite a truncated support union and an unchecked incompatible comparator. Small semantics and input-validity controls should precede larger flag censuses.
